searchText: on reddit when EIP1559 came up in discussions the top reply would go on to explain how first price auctions were ineffecient and that was a big motivation for having an algorithm choose the fee people pay instead. Maybe they were right In the end it probably doesent matter because ETH largely has a monopoly so even if fee market is slightly borked it will be fine While it's not strictly on topic, that is actually pretty interesting, thanks for sharing! Guess Google needs to bring in more $$$. FPAs are inefficient: if the bids are 1, 2, 5, then it's much more efficient to charge 2 (or 2.0001) to the winner than 5. The main problem w/ doing them on Ethereum is we don't have a trustless way of ordering the bids (e.g. if we do a 2nd Price Auction, miners will just put a bid > the top bid to bump the "true" first place to second place and charge that).
